_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: outbox_pending_record
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outbox_pending_record ON outbox (target_table, record_id) WHERE status = 'pending'

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "households" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UZS', "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Tashkent', "personal_fund_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'percent', "personal_fund_percent" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 10.0, "personal_fund_fixed_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "personal_fund_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "personal_fund_source_account_id" TEXT NULL, "auto_open_month" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_open_month" IN (0, 1)), "strict_month_lock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("strict_month_lock" IN (0, 1)), "onboarded_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UZS', "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_date" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "month_shift" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "system_code" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NULL, "day_of_month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "auto_pay" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_pay" IN (0, 1)), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "debt_id" TEXT NULL, "start_month" TEXT NULL, "end_month" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_limits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "alert_80" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("alert_80" IN (0, 1)), "alert_100" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("alert_100" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quick_actions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payee" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UZS', "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "monthly_payment" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UZS', "target" INTEGER NOT NULL, "saved_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "monthly_contribution" INTEGER NULL, "deadline" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "achieved_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "months" ("household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "closed_by" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("household_id", "month"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, "planned_amount" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "auto_pay" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_pay" IN (0, 1)), "debt_id" TEXT NULL, "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NULL, "system_code" TEXT NULL, "paid_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "settled_at" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "skipped_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_account_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_amount" INTEGER NULL, "amount_base" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fx_rate" REAL NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "payee" TEXT NULL, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_month_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "planned_item_id" TEXT NULL, "debt_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "base_row" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_pull_at" TEXT NULL, "last_push_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("household_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_issues" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "message" TEXT NULL, "server_row" TEXT NULL, "local_data" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL);
CREATE INDEX accounts_household ON accounts (household_id)
CREATE INDEX categories_household ON categories (household_id)
CREATE INDEX recurring_rules_household ON recurring_rules (household_id)
CREATE INDEX category_limits_household ON category_limits (household_id)
CREATE INDEX quick_actions_household ON quick_actions (household_id)
CREATE INDEX tags_household ON tags (household_id)
CREATE INDEX debts_household ON debts (household_id)
CREATE INDEX goals_household ON goals (household_id)
CREATE INDEX planned_items_month ON planned_items (household_id, budget_month)
CREATE INDEX planned_items_debt ON planned_items (debt_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_month ON transactions (household_id, budget_month)
CREATE INDEX transactions_list ON transactions (household_id, occurred_on, id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_to_account ON transactions (to_account_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_planned ON transactions (planned_item_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_debt ON transactions (debt_id)
CREATE INDEX transaction_tags_transaction ON transaction_tags (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX attachments_transaction ON attachments (transaction_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outbox_pending_record ON outbox (target_table, record_id) WHERE status = 'pending'
CREATE INDEX outbox_order ON outbox (household_id, id)
CREATE INDEX sync_issues_open ON sync_issues (household_id, resolved_at)
